mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO platform_alert_state(metric,status,metric_value,sample_count,window_start,window_end,policy_version,evaluated_at) VALUES
(#{s.metric},#{s.status},#{s.value},#{s.sampleCount},#{s.windowStart},#{s.windowEnd},#{s.policyVersion},#{s.evaluatedAt})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status=VALUES(status),metric_value=VALUES(metric_value),sample_count=VALUES(sample_count), window_start=VALUES(window_start),window_end=VALUES(window_end),policy_version=VALUES(policy_version),evaluated_at=VALUES(evaluated_at)
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM platform_alert_event WHERE id IN #{id}
